restaurant.name: El Farm Cafe and Restaurant
restaurant.subTagline: Your little escape in Lamitan City — Coffee • Matcha • Desserts • Good Food • Pickleball & Outdoor Experiences
restaurant.storyHeadline: Malayo Man Kami, Sulit Naman Ang Dayo.
restaurant.storyBody: Tucked away in the lush greenery of Sitio Nipa, Brgy. Maloong Canal, Lamitan City, El Farm Cafe and Restaurant was born as a warm sanctuary where rustic farm charm meets specialty coffee, authentic Basilan & Filipino comfort cuisine, and vibrant outdoor recreation. Whether you're rallying on our lighted pickleball court under the palms, sharing a Salu-Salo Bilao with family under glowing garden string lights, or savoring a Coconut Matcha Cloud in a real buko shell, every visit is crafted for meaningful moments.
restaurant.address: Sitio Nipa, Brgy. Maloong Canal, Lamitan City, Basilan, Philippines, 7302

hours.specialEvents: Tuesday Specials & Surprises (Lucky Egg Hunt) • Mon/Wed/Fri Goto Overload
hours.orderingNote: All meals are freshly prepared! Message us your advance orders ahead of your visit for faster serving, or enjoy delivery across Lamitan City (+₱100 delivery fee).

highlights.title: Heirloom Basilan & Pinoy Feasts

highlights.title: Lighted Outdoor Pickleball Court

highlights.title: Garden Tents & Warm Lantern Nights

menuItems.name: Dirty Coffee (Iced Only)
menuItems.description: Rich double-shot espresso poured over ice-cold creamy milk in a branded EL Farm clear cup — create your own swirl.

menuItems.name: Butter Caramel Popcorn Latte
menuItems.description: Buttery caramel espresso latte topped with velvety whipped cream and golden caramel popcorn crunch.

menuItems.name: Lamitan Sunrise (Orange Espresso)
menuItems.description: Refreshing citrus-infused iced espresso layered over bright golden-orange juice in our signature EL Farm cup.

menuItems.name: Iced Spanish Latte
menuItems.description: Smooth double-shot espresso blended with rich, silky sweetened condensed milk and fresh chilled milk over crystal ice.

menuItems.name: Lotus Biscoff Latte
menuItems.description: Creamy espresso latte swirled with caramelized Lotus Biscoff spread, whipped cream, and a whole Biscoff biscuit.

menuItems.name: Salted Caramel Latte
menuItems.description: Velvety espresso and milk ribboned with house-made sea-salted caramel sauce and cold milk foam.

menuItems.name: Golden Honeycomb Latte
menuItems.description: Handcrafted iced latte sweetened with wildflower honey and crowned with crisp golden honeycomb toffee crunch.

menuItems.name: Brown Sugar Cinnamon Latte
menuItems.description: Aromatic espresso shaken with dark muscovado brown sugar syrup, warm Ceylon cinnamon dust, and creamy milk.

menuItems.name: Classic Iced Americano
menuItems.description: Bold, freshly pulled double-shot signature roast espresso poured over crystal-clear artisan ice with golden crema.

menuItems.name: Coconut Matcha Cloud
menuItems.description: Refreshing young coconut water crowned with a velvety ceremonial matcha cream cloud inside a real fresh buko shell.

menuItems.name: EL Special Matcha (Dunya)
menuItems.description: Our signature ceremonial-grade Uji matcha layered over velvety vanilla sweet cream with roasted nutty notes.

menuItems.name: Ceremonial Matcha Latte
menuItems.description: Whisked ceremonial green tea matcha poured over chilled creamy milk for a vibrant, earthy, and smooth pick-me-up.

menuItems.name: Roasted Hojicha Latte
menuItems.description: Slow-roasted Japanese green tea latte with comforting notes of toasted cocoa, caramel, and warm nutty aroma.

menuItems.name: Hojicha Earl Grey Latte
menuItems.description: Artisanal fusion of roasted Japanese hojicha and fragrant bergamot-infused Earl Grey tea layered with silky milk.

menuItems.name: S'mores Campfire Smoothie
menuItems.description: Decadent dark-chocolate smoothie blend topped with flame-toasted marshmallows, rich fudge drizzle, and graham crunch.

menuItems.name: Dubai Chewy Cookie Smoothie
menuItems.description: Rich Belgian chocolate smoothie layered with roasted pistachio cream, chewy cookie crumble, and crushed pistachios.

menuItems.name: Mulberry Yoghurt Refresher
menuItems.description: Tangy probiotic farm yoghurt swirled with house-simmered dark mulberry compote in our signature EL Farm cup.

menuItems.name: Blueberry Yoghurt Refresher
menuItems.description: Creamy non-caffeinated yoghurt drink ribboned with sweet wild blueberry preserves and real berry fruit.

menuItems.name: Strawberry Yoghurt Refresher
menuItems.description: Refreshing chilled probiotic yoghurt layered with ruby-red strawberry puree and sweet fruit chunks.

menuItems.name: Classic Beef Topsilog / Tapsilog
menuItems.description: Tender sweet-savory marinated beef tapa pan-seared to perfection and served with golden garlic sinangag rice and sunny-side-up egg.

menuItems.name: Crispy Sisig Silog
menuItems.description: Solo serving of our signature crispy sizzling sisig paired with fragrant garlic fried rice and a sunny-side-up farm egg.

menuItems.name: Classic Pinoy Hotsilog
menuItems.description: Two plump, juicy red hotdogs diamond-scored and pan-fried, served alongside golden garlic fried rice and a fried egg.

menuItems.name: Putok Batok Bone Marrow Goto
menuItems.description: Velvety ginger-infused rice porridge crowned with a whole torched beef bone marrow canoe, toasted garlic, and scallions.

menuItems.name: Special Goto Overload
menuItems.description: Hearty lugaw rice porridge loaded with tender beef tripe, boiled egg, crispy garlic bits, spring onions, and calamansi.

menuItems.name: Spicy Samyang Buldak Wrap
menuItems.description: Fiery Korean Samyang buldak noodles, melted mozzarella cheese, and savory meat wrapped inside a warm toasted tortilla.

menuItems.name: Tiyula Itum (Heirloom Black Beef Soup)
menuItems.description: Basilan's iconic black beef soup slow-cooked with roasted coconut flesh, lemongrass, galangal, ginger, and native spices.

menuItems.name: Festive Chicken Kaliya
menuItems.description: Traditional Yakan festive chicken stew simmered in rich golden turmeric, toasted coconut, paminta, and heirloom herbs.

menuItems.name: Native Chicken Tinola
menuItems.description: Free-range native farm chicken slow-simmered in fragrant ginger and lemongrass broth with green papaya and chili leaves.

menuItems.name: Crispy Kare-Kareng Hito
menuItems.description: Crispy whole freshwater catfish ladled with thick roasted peanut kare-kare sauce, eggplant, string beans, and pechay.

menuItems.name: Crispy Fried Whole Hito
menuItems.description: Whole fresh hito (catfish) deep-fried until golden and crackling, served with spiced cane vinegar and soy-calamansi dip.

menuItems.name: Authentic Kambing Papaitan
menuItems.description: Tender goat meat and innards simmered in a bold, savory-citrusy ginger and garlic broth with green finger chilies.

menuItems.name: Adobing (Slow-Braised Goat Adobo)
menuItems.description: Succulent goat meat slow-braised until fork-tender in soy sauce, cane vinegar, crushed garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns.

menuItems.name: Sizzling Chicken Sisig
menuItems.description: Finely chopped grilled chicken tossed with red onions, finger chilies, calamansi, and creamy house dressing on a sizzling plate.

menuItems.name: Sizzling Bangus Sisig
menuItems.description: Flaked crispy golden milkfish (bangus) belly sizzled with diced onions, ginger, chili peppers, and fresh calamansi juice.

menuItems.name: Golden Crispy Pata
menuItems.description: Deep-fried whole pork knuckle with ultra-crispy golden crackling skin and juicy meat, served with spiced soy-vinegar dip.

menuItems.name: Sizzling Pork Sisig
menuItems.description: Savory chopped crispy pork mask and belly sizzled with onions, chili peppers, calamansi, and a fresh cracked egg on top.

menuItems.name: Special Pork Dinuguan
menuItems.description: Rich, savory pork stew slow-simmered in dark spiced gravy with crushed garlic, cane vinegar, and green finger chilies.

menuItems.name: Crispy Chix N' Fries Basket
menuItems.description: Golden crispy fried chicken bites paired with seasoned crinkle-cut French fries, house cheese dip, and tangy ketchup.

menuItems.name: Crispy Golden Calamares
menuItems.description: Tender squid rings battered in seasoned flour and fried to a light, golden crunch, served with garlic mayo and spiced vinegar.

menuItems.name: Barkadahan Special Platter
menuItems.description: Loaded sharing platter for 3–4 guests featuring crispy chicken strips, fries, golden lumpia, kropek, and trio of dips.

menuItems.name: Saging Con Ginamus
menuItems.description: Golden fried saba plantains served hot with traditional savory-spicy fermented fish dip (ginamus) squeezed with calamansi.

menuItems.name: Kamanting Con Haleya
menuItems.description: Traditional Basilan delicacy of tender steamed cassava (kamanting) topped with rich caramelized coconut jam (haleya).

menuItems.name: Fudgy Brownie Cupcakes
menuItems.description: Rich, fudgy dark-chocolate brownie cupcakes with a crinkly top, studded with chocolate chips and festive sprinkles.

menuItems.name: Seafood Feast Bilao
menuItems.description: Bountiful coastal bilao loaded with Basilan Curacha crab, garlic butter shrimp, crispy calamares, grilled fish, rice, and fruits.

menuItems.name: All-Time Favorites Combo Feast
menuItems.description: Full family feast combining a Pancit Miki Special bilao, golden Crispy Fried Chicken platter, lumpia shanghai, and hot soup.

menuItems.name: Chicken & Pancit Miki Combo
menuItems.description: Golden crispy fried chicken paired with a generous bilao of Pancit Miki Special, crispy lumpia shanghai, and boiled eggs.

menuItems.name: Pinoy Favorites Bilao
menuItems.description: Grilled barbecue skewers, salted duck eggs, ensalada, steamed white rice, and fresh watermelon & pineapple on banana leaves.

menuItems.name: Golden Chicken Bilao
menuItems.description: Crispy golden fried chicken pieces surrounded by airy prawn crackers (kropek) and served with house gravy and dips.

menuItems.name: Pancit Miki Special Bilao
menuItems.description: Stir-fried heirloom Basilan miki noodles topped with savory meats, vegetables, crispy lumpia shanghai, and sliced eggs.
